title: AI Provider Control Centre
implemented: credential-safe provider control projection over existing providerConfigs records
provider enabled-state controls using the existing enabled field
provider priority using the existing providerConfigs array order
explicit fallback policy with manual and ordered-enabled modes
fallback-plan generation that never grants runtime authority
correction of providerConfigs registry metadata from object to verified array storage shape
preserved: existing BYO provider records and credential fields
existing Retriever provider storage key providerConfigs
credential_policy: Control projections never expose API keys/tokens/secrets/passwords/credentials. Raw existing provider records are preserved only in the storage update result so existing persistence paths are not rewritten.
runtime_authority: Settings provider policy is configuration only; runtime authority, entitlements, privacy, budgets and provider availability remain separate gates.
